Usage: lyric [command] [args]

  Run `lyric` with no command inside a project to build it.

Project:
  lyric init    [<dir>] [--name <Name>] [--lib] [--force]
                (scaffold a new app (or --lib library) package: lyric.toml + src + .gitignore)
  lyric build   [<source.l>] [-o <output>] [--force] [--manifest <lyric.toml>] [--target dotnet|jvm|native] [--triple <llvm-triple>] [--opt 0|1|2|3|s] [--no-restore] [--watch] [--define KEY=VALUE]
                 (--define injects a compile-time String into a @build_const val, docs/60)
                (no source: builds the discovered project's [project.packages] into one DLL;
                 auto-restores deps when lyric.lock is missing or stale unless --no-restore)
  lyric build   [--debug | --release] [--shape portable|standalone|aot]
                (two independent axes, both orthogonal to --target -- docs/63:
                 PROFILE  --debug (default) unoptimized, debug info kept
                          --release        optimized, debug info stripped
                 SHAPE    --shape portable (default)  framework-dependent; needs a runtime
                          --shape standalone          bundles a runtime -- not implemented (#6262)
                          --shape aot                 native binary; --aot is sugar for this
                 --standalone/--aot are sugar for the matching --shape)
  lyric build   --release --aot [<source.l>] [--manifest <lyric.toml>] [--rid <rid>] [-o <bin>]
                (self-contained native binary; no source: builds the discovered project.
                 NOTE: --release alone no longer implies AOT -- it selects the profile only)
  lyric check   [<source.l>...] [--manifest <lyric.toml>] [--target dotnet|jvm]
                (type-check without producing a usable output artifact)
  lyric clean   [<dir>] [--manifest <lyric.toml>]
                (remove bin/, .lyric-run/, .lyric-test/, .lyric-bench/, .lyric-check/, .lyric-release/)
  lyric bindgen <header.h> --package <Name> --allow <file> [-o <out.l>] [--library
